The architecture crumbles in `astropy/modeling/separable.py`, within the `_separable` function. When it encounters a `CompoundModel`, it must recursively descend through nested structures. The bug lies in how it handles the `&` operator for already-compound models.

Specifically, in the `_separable` function around line 242-306, when processing `CompoundModel` with operator `&`, the code calls `_cstack` which builds a block-diagonal matrix.     elif isinstance(transform, Model):
